description.zh: 在搜索框里执行 shell 命令：手动输入或直接执行剪贴板内容，支持 cmd、PowerShell、Git Bash、MSYS2、WSL 和自定义 shell；普通命令结果在列表里实时刷新，Ctrl+Enter 在终端里打开；可经 UAC 确认以管理员在终端窗口执行（仅 cmd 和 PowerShell，窗口跑完留存）。
description.en: Run shell commands from the search box: type them or run the clipboard's content. Supports cmd, PowerShell 7, Git Bash, MSYS2, WSL and custom shells; normal commands refresh their results live in the list, Ctrl+Enter runs them in a terminal, and cmd and PowerShell can run as administrator in a terminal window after a UAC prompt (the window stays).
